research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Zeit Medical is researching an EEG signal detecting headband and a wearable real time stroke detector apparatus. The EEG signal monitoring headband aims to improve EEG signal acquisition for better detection and diagnosis of stroke and other neurological conditions. The stroke monitor uses EEG skin electrodes, signal processor circuitry and power spectral density circuitry for real time stroke detection. Together these efforts focus on wearable EEG neuromonitoring and real time stroke detection.

overview_description.description:
Zeit Medical provides therapy for neurological injuries by identifying signature patterns in EEG and enables physicians to diagnose and treat with precision. 

The company was founded in 20202019 by Urs Naber and Orestis Vardoulis.
